event.title: Trump Criticizes Jeanine Pirro Over Reflecting Pool Vandalism Case Decision
event.canonical_title: Trump Criticizes Jeanine Pirro Over Reflecting Pool Vandalism Case Decision
event.summary: Donald Trump publicly disagreed with US Attorney Jeanine Pirro regarding her decision to drop a vandalism case involving the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. He labeled the damage as 'VANDALISM' and expressed his disapproval on Truth Social, marking a significant break with Pirro, a longtime ally.

timeline.title: Trump Criticizes Pirro for Dropping Vandalism Case Against Former Olympian
timeline.summary: President Donald Trump expressed disapproval of Jeanine Pirro's decision to drop the vandalism case against a former Olympic canoeist accused of damaging the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool. The US Justice Department has officially dismissed the charges against the athlete.
key_facts: Trump criticized Pirro for dropping the case.
The case involved a former Olympic canoeist accused of vandalizing the Reflecting Pool.
The US Justice Department dropped the charges.
